in_marathi.name: Krivansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krivansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kri- (to create) and Vansh (progeny or lineage). This name signifies the one who brings prosperity and success to his lineage.

in_bengali.name: Krivansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bringer of prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Krivansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Kri- (to create) and Vansh (progeny or lineage). This name signifies the one who brings prosperity and success to his lineage.
